Definition: Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ishmaiah = "Jehovah will hear"; 1) a Gibeonite and one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a son of Obadiah and the ruler of the tribe of Zebulun in the time of king David
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
